tools.name: dex_analyze_orderbook_depth
tools.description:
Use this when you need to analyze liquidity depth of a Uniswap V3 pool before a large trade. Returns depth analysis in JSON.

1. currentPrice: current pool price
2. depth1pct: USD liquidity available within 1% price impact
3. depth2pct: USD liquidity available within 2% price impact
4. depth5pct: US
